Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 1968/2019

Dear Mr. Mehra,

Thank you for meeting us on 4 July 2019 about your dispute with M/s Coastal Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kochi.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kochi
